easyPrerequisites: Rescue Girl doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}, plus an additional {2}{U} for its replicate cost.
Ugin's Nexus's replicate ability triggers, copying it.
Resolve the copy of the Ugin's Nexus spell, creating a token copy of it.
Resolve the original Ugin's Nexus spell. Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Bounce Ugin's Nexus back to your hand using Rescue Girl.
Move to your next turn and repeat from step 1.
